people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

translations.web: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
translations.bsb: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
translations.kjv: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
